title: Mechanical Double Enzyme Technique for Isolating and Culturing Primary Chondrocytes
author: Yao, Kulyar, et al.
materials: Alexa Fluor® 488 labeled goat anti-rabbit IgG

steps.title: Prepare culture medium
steps.instruction: Mix high‑glucose DMEM (86% of final volume) with Australian fetal bovine serum (12%) and Penicillin‑Streptomycin antibiotic (1%) to obtain the complete cell culture medium.

steps.title: Prepare digestive solution
steps.instruction: In 100 mL of the prepared culture medium add 100 mg type IV collagenase and hyaluronidase (amount as used in the original protocol) to make the digestive solution.

steps.title: Sterilize tibia and expose growth plate
steps.instruction: On an aseptic table, separate the chicken tibia, immerse it in 75 % ethanol for 10 min, then use a scalpel to remove the articular cartilage at the top until the growth plate is visible.

steps.title: Mince and wash growth plate
steps.instruction: Cut the exposed growth plate into small pieces, wash the pieces twice with PBS, and transfer them into a narrow‑necked vial containing the digestive solution.

steps.title: Digest tissue fragments
steps.instruction: Using sterile ophthalmic scissors, further mince the pieces into a crumb‑like consistency, then incubate the fragments in the digestive solution for 11.5 h at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂ on a shaker.

steps.title: Filter and centrifuge cell suspension
steps.instruction: Pass the digested mixture through a 70 µm cell sieve, centrifuge the filtrate at 800 rpm for 8 min, discard the supernatant, and wash the cell pellet once with culture medium.

steps.title: Seed primary chondrocytes
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed cells in the prepared culture medium and place the suspension in a 37 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator until cells reach ~80 % confluency.

steps.title: Passage cells with trypsin‑EDTA
steps.instruction: When confluency reaches 80 %, add 0.25 % trypsin‑EDTA solution and incubate for 40 s at 37 °C with 5 % CO₂, then neutralize, resuspend the cells in fresh culture medium, and re‑plate onto new dishes.

steps.title: Assess viability with trypan blue
steps.instruction: Prepare sterile 0.4 % trypan blue solution. Mix cell suspension with trypan blue at a 9:1 ratio, gently mix, and stain for 3 min. Observe under an inverted microscope, count live and blue‑stained cells using a hemocytometer, and calculate viability as (total‑blue)/total × 100 %.
